> Documentation index: https://firebase.google.com/support/llms.txt

This page provides a changelog that lists new SDK releases and describes updates
to the Firebase console and Firebase services. To learn about specific
releases, click the links in the changelog below.

Release notes for 2016-2023 are in the
[release notes archive](https://firebase.google.com/support/release-notes/archive/releases_archive.md.txt).

## November 19, 2026

### SDK Releases

- The [Firebase SDK for Unity
  (v14.2.0)](https://firebase.google.com/support/release-notes/unity#14.2.0) is now available. This release includes new features in Authentication and Firebase AI, changes to App Check and Realtime Database, and other changes.

## November 18, 2026

### Firebase CLI (v15.37.0)

- The latest
  [Firebase CLI (v15.37.0)](https://firebase.google.com/support/release-notes/cli.md.txt#15.37.0) is now
  available. This version adds Node.js 26 runtime (Preview) support for
  Cloud Functions, adds `filterExpression` to the Crashlytics MCP
  `get_report` tool, fixes `--dry-run` Cloud Firestore database creation and
  2nd gen function deploy issues, improves `crashlytics:heapdumps` security and
  validation, and updates the Firebase SQL Connect local toolkit to
  v3.4.28.

  To use the Firebase CLI in your development environment,
  [set up or update the CLI](https://firebase.google.com/docs/cli.md.txt#setup_update_cli).

### Firebase AI Logic

- Firebase AI Logic supports the latest Gemini stable
